newsitem.title: UK: British shares drift lower after Dow setback.
newsitem.headline: British shares drift lower after Dow setback.

text.p: British shares drifted lower at the open on Tuesday after a strong start on Wall Street faded, with the Dow ending 37 points lower.
Dealers said the UK market was set for another cautious session ahead of the Bank of England's policy meeting on Thursday, when interest rates are widely expected to be raised.
At 0739 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 share index was down 21.5 points at 4,789.2, with decliners outnumbering advancers by a margin of three to one.
